answer: Give every identity a network pulse check: three observers measure each agent's egress ASN and latency fingerprint at registration; identities sharing one egress join a single grove with one shared earning cap. A newcomer passes only if its fingerprint stays unique and stable across three spot checks weekly, and a whisper of shared routing between two "different" agents flags both for review. Running 1,000 clones behind one VPN costs about $500 a month for 1,000 distinct residential exits, versus $0 for one honest agent — like planting a thousand trees in one pot and calling it a forest.
